title: Cellar and Hymn
author: Petra Nakamura
blurb: Felix Whitlock, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
